title: 10 Bullets, #8: "ALWAYS BE KNOLLING". By Tom Sachs
summary: A one-minute clip from Tom Sachs's Ten Bullets series on the rule "Always Be Knolling", which means constantly arranging and putting away unused objects.
why: Used as a short intro to knolling and as an analogy for tidying workspaces and continuously cleaning up code.

quote.text: there's something about it that makes me want to go back and watch it every couple years for inspiration
